title: Not as good as I’d hoped.
text: Not as good as I’d hoped.. So much smaller than I had hoped. I am praying the larger ones can continue to hold a medium size hanging basket. Each size is a different sheen? Why?? One is SUPER shiny, the other matte. I doubt I’ll ever be able to use the teeny ones.
